summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing amendments to an existing Any Market Purchase Agreement (AMPA) with Alumni Capital LP. The amendments reduce the settlement timeline for purchase notices to no more than two business days and extend the agreement's term to June 30, 2027. The equity line of credit remains at $8 million. No shares were purchased or sold in the filing; it is a routine contractual modification. The amendments are effective upon registration of resale shares. No recommended action or advisor is named.
